scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c magenta,cyan "cd apps/api && {{packageManager}} run dev" "cd apps/web && {{packageManager}} run dev"
scripts.build: cd apps/api && {{packageManager}} run build && cd ../web && {{packageManager}} run build
scripts.typecheck: cd apps/api && {{packageManager}} run typecheck && cd ../web && {{packageManager}} run typecheck
